finalPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: decorative background graphic for a video, opaque landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080.
Primary request: テーマに関係のない、適度に模様がある背景。人物は描かない。
Design a finished, tasteful video background with a moderate amount of abstract ornament and generous breathing room. Use a soft muted blue-to-teal base, with a few broad softly translucent curved bands drifting around the edges, several faint overlapping circles, and small sparse dot clusters. Give the motifs varied scale and opacity so the background has gentle rhythm and visual interest. A subtle fine paper-like surface texture may unify it.
Keep the middle portion mostly quiet with a smooth, gentle tonal field, suitable for overlaid scene illustrations and readable captions. The abstract forms should be visible enough to feel designed but remain secondary to foreground content. Calm, friendly, slightly polished presentation-background mood, cohesive restrained color palette, soft shapes with elegant transitions. No single dominant object.
Do not cover the whole surface with an evenly repeated grid or dense tiny pattern. No hard diamond lattice, no checkerboard, no uniform wire mesh. Do not make it an almost blank gray swatch. Do not make it flashy, neon, high-contrast or visually crowded.
Mandatory constraints: abstract decorative shapes only; no people, faces, silhouettes, rooms, furniture, food, fantasy imagery, recognizable scenery or thematic symbols. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, sample panels, border or mockup. One full-bleed background image.
